overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the recording restriction was not a violation because only one Board member (the Chair) attended the hearing, so no quorum was present and it was not a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board restricted his right to record a September 21, 2022 hearing on his property tax appeals.
allegations.key_passage: Although Mr. Dominatto was not allowed to record the hearing held on September 21, 2022, we do not find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law because this hearing was not a meeting subject to the Open Meeting Law.
